headline: CHW @ SEA matchup research
quickWriteup: The current model score is CHW 4.37 at SEA 4.54, with a projected total of 8.92. Movement read: The side movement strengthened toward CHW: CHW moved +0.70 runs while SEA moved +0.24, changing the projected margin by +0.46 runs. The projected total climbed +0.95, which points to more offensive expectation than the earliest saved read. Pitching context: Noah Schultz has the better recent run-prevention profile in the available outing logs at 2.6 ER over the last 5 outings. Batter research is strongest for Miguel Vargas, Randy Arozarena, Colson Montgomery, based on recent hit rates, matching location/opponent samples, or similar-game production. The cold/risk list flags Leo Rivas, Rob Refsnyder because the recent hit profile or strikeout trend is weaker than the projection alone would show.
